# TradeGrowth Marketing

> Marketing for UK construction, engineering and design businesses. We help
> architects, MEP and building services engineers, structural engineers and
> interior designers — along with related built-environment consultancies and
> contractors — showcase their expertise, improve their visibility in search and
> in AI-assisted search, and attract more relevant project enquiries.

Website: https://tradegrowthseo.com
Contact: contact@tradegrowthseo.com
Coverage: United Kingdom, remote-first
Serves: UK construction, engineering and design businesses (not ecommerce or
  national consumer brands)
Availability: Taking on new clients

## Who we work with

Primary disciplines:

- Architects and architectural practices
- MEP and building services engineers
- Structural engineers
- Interior designers and interior architecture studios

Also working with: civil engineering consultancies; building and quantity
surveyors; planning consultants; energy and sustainability consultants;
landscape architects; project management and construction consultancies;
specialist electrical and EV infrastructure design consultancies; main
contractors, design-and-build firms and specialist construction contractors.

Clients range from practices serving homeowners on residential projects to
consultancies selling to developers, contractors, architects and estates teams.

## What we do

- **Website design** — 10-page, mobile-first websites organised around project
  portfolios, case studies, specialisms, sector experience and team credentials,
  with a straightforward enquiry journey. From £500 one-off — animations and
  larger builds cost more. Domain registered in the client's name; hosting and
  SSL included for the first year.
- **SEO + AI-search visibility** (headline service) — search visibility for the
  client's services, project types and locations, targeted locally, regionally
  or nationally to match their actual market, including Google Business Profile
  management. Alongside it, the groundwork that makes a practice legible to
  AI-assisted search: structured data, question-led content, consistent business
  information and llms.txt. No ranking, citation or AI recommendation is
  guaranteed; monthly reporting covers what can actually be observed.
- **Google & Meta ads** — Google Search led, because the intent is specific;
  Meta where the work is visual or for audience follow-up. Ad spend is paid by
  the client directly to the platforms. LinkedIn Ads management is not offered.
- **Enquiry management & follow-up** — keeping project enquiries organised and
  making follow-up easier. A practical CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel, white-labelled)
  configured to capture enquiries from agreed sources, track consultations and
  proposals, and remind the client's team when action is due. Includes contact
  and company records, a project-enquiry pipeline, website enquiry capture from
  connected forms, consultation booking where configured, internal tasks and
  reminders, agreed acknowledgement and follow-up workflows, and reporting based
  on recorded activity and outcomes.

  TradeGrowth configures and maintains the agreed system. The client's team
  assesses project suitability, prepares proposals, handles sales conversations
  and records progress. We do not chase proposals on the client's behalf, qualify
  opportunities or close sales, and there is no AI telephone answering or human
  appointment setting in the offering.

  Package scope: Basic — enquiry tracking foundations (one CRM workspace with
  client access, contact records, one project-enquiry pipeline, one connected
  website enquiry form, internal new-enquiry notification, one handover session;
  no automated proposal-follow-up sequence). Standard — everything in Basic plus
  one consultation-booking calendar connection, up to three agreed standard
  workflows, simple pipeline-stage tailoring, and basic source and outcome
  reporting where the data is captured. Premium — everything in Standard plus a
  monthly review of recorded enquiry and proposal activity, reporting on recorded
  sources, stages and outcomes, and one minor adjustment to an existing workflow
  per month (copy, timing or an existing condition — not a new integration or
  custom development).

  It does not replace design, analysis, project management or accounting
  software.

## Scope and costs

- The monthly fee covers configuration and management of the scope listed for
  the tier. There is no separate setup fee.
- Software licences, messaging, telephone, third-party integration and usage
  charges are itemised and agreed before activation. Messaging is not unlimited
  and not every software cost is absorbed.
- Data migrations, custom integrations, additional pipelines and substantial
  workflow builds are scoped and quoted separately.
- An existing client CRM is assessed before any replacement is recommended.
- Reporting depends on connected sources and the client recording outcomes.
- CRM access, ongoing software costs and data-export arrangements on
  cancellation are agreed during onboarding. The underlying software is
  licensed, not owned.

## Pricing (published in full)

- The Website: from £500 one-off (50% deposit, 50% on launch). Animations and
  larger builds cost more. No monthly commitment.
- Basic: £395/month plus the one-off website fee. 3 month minimum.
- Standard: £495/month plus the one-off website fee. 3 month minimum. Most popular.
- Premium: £595/month plus the one-off website fee. 6 month minimum.

Each monthly package includes everything in the tier below it. Full comparison:
https://tradegrowthseo.com/pricing/

## Case study

EV Design — an electrical design consultancy based in Burnley, Lancashire,
specialising in EV charging infrastructure and working on projects across the
UK. Ranks first on Google for local Burnley searches, is named in Google's AI
Overview as a North West specialist, and is described accurately by ChatGPT.
These are visibility results, evidenced by screenshots of live searches; no
enquiry or revenue figures are attributed to them.
